name: Waterloo Space Research Team (WSRT)
description: Empowers undergraduate students to explore space research through stratospheric balloon payloads and microgravity electronics experiments.

cycles.notes: The site's join form and the application forms posted on Instagram (@uwspaceresearch) are still from the 2025-26 cycle, nothing posted yet for the upcoming year. Check Instagram for the new form once it's live. Runs stratospheric balloon payloads and microgravity experiments.
